status: fitted_and_engineering_verified; see benchmark for scientific outcome
scope: Model/backend contract; frontend implementation belongs to other chats
selection: fusion_model is exclusive with video_model and transfer_models; omitted preserves v1 behavior
inference_input: Existing PublicMediaRequest and source file; text requires explicit words_per_minute and documents require seconds_per_page
local_prediction_entrypoint: python -m brain.fusion_inference --native TRIBE_DIRECTORY --model MODEL_DIRECTORY --output NEW_DIRECTORY --duration SECONDS --input-format FORMAT [--features VERIFIED_VIDEO_FEATURE_DIRECTORY]

output.arrays: prediction/predictions.npz: existing EEG queries, eight EEG features, support mask, native cortical response and native cortical times
output.manifest: prediction/manifest.json: existing bundle fields plus fusion model version, artifact hash, available modalities, evaluation status and benchmark reference
output.diagnostics: unsupported intervals, missing modalities, prototype signal/timing limitations and variance-domain checks
output.JSON: NaN becomes null; retain explicit support flags
output.EEG: TP9 AF7 AF8 TP10 means followed by log1p variances; 44-second context, five-second hop; not attention or retention
output.fMRI: Unmodified pretrained TRIBE predictions; separate native clock; not observed student measurements

transfer: Absent representation/descriptor blocks are zeroed and reported; nonvideo use remains experimental transfer
runtime: Existing cloud encoders, local small EEG network; no participant EEG or fitted EEG weights uploaded
failures: Reject conflicting models, bad artifact hashes and insufficient duration before paid work. Preserve completed cloud outputs and partial local results; do not retry paid inference automatically.
frontend_requirements: keep EEG and cortical clocks separate
do not turn content observations into attention/learning scores
no synthetic brain data in live results
app_server_guidance: Run brain.content_pipeline.run in a background Python worker, not the browser or an HTTP event loop. Return a job ID, then serve the verified prediction bundle after completion. The EEG artifact remains local; remote adapters receive only content.
JSON_cortex_policy: JSON carries unchanged native cortical clocks and a checksummed NPZ reference. A local backend can serve the required cortical slices; no brain-region labels or physiological calibration are invented.
scientific_status: exploratory_revision_after_v2; inspect uncertainty and negative control
